risk_note: RV2 admin task (admin module, app.module, contract and generated route tables): implements the admin audit log query of contract CT-24c, removing x-implementation planned from GET /admin/v1/audit-logs and /{id}. A read-only reader separate from the append-only AuditPort (the writer still has only append); a pure action/target mapping derives target_type / target_id / permission (pre-registered for claim_item_* and export_*; kill_switch_change, commission.rule.* and union.account.* give null and never match a permission filter; an unknown permission answers an empty page). Without audit.view_all (checked through AdminProfiles, super admins hold all) actor_id is forced to the caller and another admin's record answers like a missing one (20001 [id]); app isolation. Opaque id: deterministic single-block AES under a key derived with FieldCrypto.blindIndex('audit-log-id'), prefix aud_, stable across data-key rotation, no primary key exposed. actor_name is display_name, else login name. Querying writes no audit. Contract examples now use the real action names. app.module imports content's config registry directly (content index does not export it yet; TODO and follow-up recorded). Rule tests (41, [AC-B1-34a#n]) written by Codex in three runs (r2 after the Claude spec-test review, r3 only a type-compatible signature in one helper), red before the implementation, green after; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run.
